UNCLE WIGGILY HAS A MESSAGE FOR YOU Dear Boys and Girls:— I know you will like this little book, and I want to tell you something else that my author-father, Mr. Garis, has done for you. He has made a wonderful game, played on a big, beautiful, colored board. It’s all about me and he calls it The Uncle Wiggily Game It is sold by all stores and toy-dealers. Ask for The Uncle Wiggily Game. Yours for happy hours. Uncle Wiggily HIS MARK
